_comment: Stagenet test fixtures only - stagenet XMR has no monetary value, so persisting these keys here is safe and deliberate (it lets the E2E test in e2e/README.md be re-run without regenerating wallets or re-funding from the faucet every time). Never do this with mainnet keys.

spender.mnemonic: affair cube ablaze cynical lurk gather arises last oatmeal guide sniff tufts lyrics wounded zigzags deftly tapestry tipsy pests ingested vain feast cottage duration wounded
spender.role: The payer - needs full spend capability to receive faucet funds and send the test payment to whatever address moneropay derives for an order. The e2e suites use private_spend_key/private_view_key directly (via the monero-wallet crate, through stagenet-test-wallet::WalletStore) to scan for its own received outputs and sign a real spend, with no external wallet-rpc process involved. private_spend_key/private_view_key were extracted once via `monero-wallet-rpc`'s query_key RPC (run in --offline mode, since a wedge was observed when query_key raced an online wallet-rpc's automatic post-restore refresh); the mnemonic is kept only as a human-recoverable backup of the same key material. Renamed from `customer` once stagenet-test-wallet grew a general-purpose `WalletStore`/CLI, not just this e2e suite's own fixture - the old `known_txids` list (a leftover from the pre-ledger predecessor wallet, dead since stagenet-test-wallet's own ledger took over) was dropped in the same pass, confirmed unread by any current code.

merchant.mnemonic: yahoo friendly keyboard duckling ablaze likewise hiker kiosk hacksaw session ardent twice sowed lamb zigzags ourselves atrium omnibus otherwise bikini sunken goodbye wetsuit ablaze friendly
merchant.role: Moneropay's own tenant under test, real spend capability recorded here like any other stagenet fixture wallet (there's no reason to withhold it - this is worthless stagenet XMR in source control, and full recovery/spendability is strictly more useful, e.g. sweeping funds back to `spender` via the CLI). Only view_key_hex/spend_pubkey_hex (the *public* spend key, derived locally from private_spend_key, never transmitted) are ever given to moneropay's own real connect API though - the e2e tests still only exercise it as a genuinely watch-only tenant, exactly as a real merchant's moneropay integration would be. private_spend_key was derived from the mnemonic below (already present, unused until now) via stagenet-test-wallet's own seed-derivation code and confirmed to reproduce this exact address and private_view_key.
